To return to this chooser, press Open Scene from the menu, then scroll down and press MainMenu.json.

If you see plugin Errors, or the User Preferences menu appears, go to the Security tab and check the enable plugins box (enables important features of Easy Mate) then close the Virt-a-Mate (VAM) menu.

To open/close the the VAM menu, press B/Y on the Oculus Controllers or the menu button on the Vive.

Hold the menu button to drag the menu into position.

The menu shows important controller buttons like Select and Grab World (move).

Choose a scene to load by pressing any image.

If you don't know how to use VAM, to load the MainMenu.json scene, or to Possess a player, start by opening the Basics & Getting Started Tutorial.

To dramatically speed up scene loading times, copy/move VAM to an SSD or USB 3.1 drive.
C&G Studio recommends opening the VAM menu and checking Freeze Motion/Sound before loading a C&G Studio scene. Once the scene loads uncheck Freeze Motion/Sound for perfect sync.
